title: How wrong can the tax be?

predict.q: MEC = 20; the market alone gives a welfare loss of 100. Above what tax is society worse off than with no tax at all?

options.fb: A tax a little above the MEC overshoots, but the new loss (25 at a tax of 30) is still smaller than the 100 with no tax. Failure means worse than no intervention.
At 40 the loss is back to 100; above that it passes 100 (225 at 50, 400 at 60).

options.s: None: any tax on pollution helps
options.fb: A big enough tax cuts output so far that the lost value of useful units exceeds the harm avoided: above 40 the loss passes 100.

task: Move the **tax** slider from 0 to 60. Compare the welfare loss with the no-tax loss of 100.

target.do: Move the tax slider past 40, then press Check.

takeaway: A tax a little wrong still helps. A tax far too high can do more harm than the externality.
